svg.title: FlowBatt RUL prediction: original five-panel paper figure
svg.desc: Original paper Figure 4 in one row: MATR-1, MATR-2, HUST, MIX-100 and MIX-20. Prediction versus reference RUL. Cyan-to-magenta color shows the standard deviation of RUL from ten generated SOH trajectories per sample. Original markers, ranges, grids, ticks, pink identity lines and individual colorbars are preserved; only the font is Source Sans 3.
